## Quality Checklist
- [ ] Category folder uses `kebab-case` naming.
- [ ] Skill folder uses `kebab-case` naming.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` contains valid YAML frontmatter with `name` and `description`.
- [ ] YAML `name` exactly matches the skill folder name.
- [ ] Description specifies concrete trigger conditions.
- [ ] Instructions are deterministic, actionable, and free of vendor or product marketing terms.
- [ ] No unnecessary binaries, runtime packages, or wrapper files are included.
